name: CHD Chemicals Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2013, CHD Chemicals Limited
is in the business of trading of chemicals and dyes.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CHDCL is engaged in trading and distribution 
of chemicals and dyes. It supplies products to
 the textile, leather, paper, and construction industries and focuses mainly on high-quality chemicals and dyes for the textile sector.
